```sql
WITH
full_vaccination_4 AS (
  SELECT
    District,
    "Children age 12-23 months fully vaccinated (%)" AS nfhs4_percentage
  FROM district_health_factsheet
  WHERE
    State = 'Bihar'
    AND "Survey Round" = 'NFHS-4'
    AND "Source" = 'District factsheet'
),
full_vaccination_5 AS (
  SELECT
    District,
    "Children age 12-23 months fully vaccinated (%)" AS nfhs5_percentage
  FROM district_health_factsheet
  WHERE
    State = 'Bihar'
    AND "Survey Round" = 'NFHS-5'
    AND "Source" = 'District factsheet'
)
SELECT
  fv4.District,
  fv4.nfhs4_percentage,
  fv5.nfhs5_percentage,
  (fv5.nfhs5_percentage - fv4.nfhs4_percentage) AS percentage_point_change
FROM full_vaccination_4 fv4
JOIN full_vaccination_5 fv5 ON fv4.District = fv5.District
ORDER BY fv4.District;
```
